prompt_md: A solid cube 1 m on each side is cut into 1 cm cubes. All the small cubes are lined up in a single row. How long is the row, in km?
prompt_short: 1 m cube cut into 1 cm cubes, laid in one row. Length in km?
hint_md: How many 1 cm cubes fit in a 1 m cube?
explain_intuition_md: A 1 m cube holds 100 by 100 by 100 small cubes, a million of them. A million centimetres is 10 km, far more than the 100 m you get if you forget a dimension.
